description: Get driving directions between any two addresses, with current traffic factored into your estimated arrival time. Search for restaurants, shops, services and other places near a location, and see how far away each one is. Look up the exact coordinates for an address, or find the nearest address for a set of coordinates. Running errands or making deliveries? Give MapQuest your list of stops and it will work out the most efficient order to visit them. Traffic incidents and construction along your route are flagged so you know what to expect before you leave.
